title: Auto-Renew, Grace and Suspension Figures — Web Hosting Plans
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — auto-renew attempts, grace and suspension, by tier**

| Figure | Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro | Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auto-renew on by default for a new plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| First auto-renew attempt, calendar days before the term end date | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Retry days after a declined first attempt, calendar days before the term end date | 3 and 1 | 3 and 1 | 3 and 1 | 3 and 1 | 3 and 1 | 3 and 1 |
| Grace after the term end date before suspension of an unpaid plan, calendar days | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Data retention of a plan suspended for non-payment, calendar days from the suspension date | 14 | 14 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Reactivation fee after suspension for non-payment, USD | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Days after a resource overage notice to return within limits before suspension | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Usage level that sends an overage warning, percent of the inode or storage limit | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |

**Explanatory notes**

- Every figure in days is a count of calendar days.
- The grace figure is the number of calendar days after the term end date during which an unpaid plan keeps running.
- The retention figure is counted from the suspension date and is the time a plan suspended for non-payment is kept before termination.
- The warning level is a percentage of the plan's inode limit or storage limit.

**Calendar illustration (hypothetical term end date of 18 October).** With the figures above, the first auto-renew attempt falls on 11 October, and retries after a declined first attempt fall on 15 October and 17 October.
